A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
the TNM classification is a useful instrument in the surgical treatment of hepatocarcinoma.
the pTN system is of prognostic value in patients with hepatocellulare carcinoma and that the therapeutic approach should be based on the individual tumor stage.

liver resection should be the first choice for patients with primary liver cancer and a resectable lesion, whereas transplantation should be considered in cases of noncurative surgery or recurrent disease.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the TNM classification is of prognostic value for both resection and transplantation.
liver transplantation should be considered for patients with hepatocancer who have a tumor that cannot be removed by resection, and for patients who have recurrent tumors after resection.
